name: portus
description: portus — agentic terminal: mission control for multiple AI agent CLI sessions
author: Adolfo Marinucci

scripts.build: npm run build:bundle && npm run build:css
scripts.sidecar:build: dotnet publish sidecar/Portus.Sidecar.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o dist/sidecar
scripts.sidecar:build:mac: dotnet publish sidecar/Portus.Sidecar.csproj -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o dist/sidecar
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run sidecar:build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run sidecar:build:mac && electron-builder --mac --publish never
